name: hide-ui-elements
description: Hide electerm's accessories — tab-bar buttons, session icons, footer buttons — one switch each.
author: ZHAO Xudong

electerm.name: Hide UI Elements
electerm.description: Hide electerm's accessories — tab-bar buttons, session icons, footer buttons — one switch each.

configs.name: hideAll
configs.label: Hide everything below
configs.description: One switch for all of them. The tab bar keeps its tabs and the terminal keeps its space; the switches below are then ignored.

configs.name: hideTabBarMenu
configs.label: Layout menu
configs.description: Tab row, right end: split layouts, the tab list and window options.

configs.name: hidePaneSwitch
configs.label: Terminal / File manager switch
configs.description: The two tabs above the terminal. The pane still switches from the right-click menu and the keyboard shortcut.

configs.name: hideSessionIcons
configs.label: Session icons
configs.description: Above the terminal: split view, sftp path follows ssh, keepalive, broadcast input, word wrap, exit.

configs.name: hideSearchFullscreen
configs.label: Search and fullscreen icons
configs.description: Above the terminal, right end, plus the font-size icons on touch screens.

configs.name: hideFooterAi
configs.label: AI button
configs.description: Footer, left end: opens the AI panel.

configs.name: hideFooterButtons
configs.label: History, quick command, triggers
configs.description: Footer, next to the AI button, plus the arrow that brings a collapsed sidebar back.

configs.name: hideFooterBatchInput
configs.label: Batch input
configs.description: Footer, middle: one command, several tabs.

configs.name: hideFooterEncoding
configs.label: Encoding and info
configs.description: Footer, right end: the encoding dropdown and the session-info icon.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Apply on launch
configs.description: Re-apply on every launch. This is the switch that puts the widget in electerm's auto-run list.

zh_cn.name: 隐藏界面元素
zh_cn.description: 逐项隐藏 electerm 的附属控件：标签栏按钮、会话工具栏图标、底栏按钮。

hideAll.label: 隐藏下面所有元素
hideAll.description: 一个开关隐藏全部。标签栏保留标签，终端保留原有空间；此时下面各项单独开关不再生效。

hideTabBarMenu.label: 布局菜单
hideTabBarMenu.description: 标签行最右端：分屏布局、标签列表、窗口选项。

hidePaneSwitch.label: 终端 / 文件管理切换
hidePaneSwitch.description: 终端上方的两个标签页。仍可用右键菜单和快捷键切换面板。

hideSessionIcons.label: 会话图标
hideSessionIcons.description: 终端上方：分屏、SFTP 路径跟随 SSH、keepalive、广播输入、自动换行、退出。

hideSearchFullscreen.label: 搜索和全屏图标
hideSearchFullscreen.description: 终端上方右端，以及触屏上的字号图标。

hideFooterAi.label: AI 按钮
hideFooterAi.description: 底栏左端：打开 AI 面板。

hideFooterButtons.label: 历史、快捷命令、触发器
hideFooterButtons.description: 底栏 AI 按钮旁边，以及侧栏折叠后用来展开的箭头。

hideFooterBatchInput.label: 批量输入框
hideFooterBatchInput.description: 底栏中间：把同一条命令发送到多个标签。

hideFooterEncoding.label: 编码和会话信息
hideFooterEncoding.description: 底栏右端：编码下拉框和会话信息图标。

autoRun.label: 启动时生效
autoRun.description: 每次启动都重新应用。这个开关会把 widget 加入 electerm 的自动运行列表。
